title: Crispy Tempeh Kebabs with Herbal Zest
description: A flavorful and healthy fusion of tempeh, herbs, and spices, perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: Herbal Zest
ingredients.notes: Combine dried thyme, rosemary, and oregano

ingredients.name: Crispy Spice
ingredients.notes: Mix paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder

instructions: Cut tempeh into 1-inch cubes and place in a bowl.
Mix herbal zest, crispy spice, lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a separate bowl.
Pour the spice mixture over the tempeh and toss to coat.
Thread tempeh onto bamboo skewers, leaving space between each piece.
Grill kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until golden brown.
